summary: The genres this kit refuses to let an installed surface accumulate. Each was ruled out by name during the layout study; each is stated here as DATA so that the ruling is executable rather than advisory, and so that a host can see the whole of it without reading a proposal.

genres.because: vendored superseded text carries no date and no author, so a later reader finds it, cannot tell when it stopped being true, and obeys it.
genres.instead: in the upstream repository's history, indexed by its changelog -- a chapter worth keeping is not archived, it is current.

genres.because: the genre records HOW a rule was learned, which is a lifecycle stage and not a home; a folder named after the intake is a graveyard by construction, and its rows never leave it.
genres.instead: under the concern it governs -- portable identity in the doctrine plane, environment-conditional doctrine beside the condition it declares, a host incident in the host's own shared knowledge.

genres.because: an append-only release record grows with the framework's age rather than this host's needs, so every host would carry the full history of versions it never ran.
genres.instead: upstream, read at the moment of need: the delta between the version this host has and the version it is moving to is a projection computed at upgrade time, never a vendored artifact.
